name: Suspicious Curl File Upload - Linux
description: Detects a curl process start that adds a file to a web request, a common exfiltration-over-web-service pattern. Adapted from SigmaHQ. Source: detections/rules/proc_creation_lnx_susp_curl_fileupload.yml, hand-converted from Sigma.
query: any where process.executable like~ "*/curl" and process.title like~ ("*--form*", "*--upload-file *", "*--data *", "*--data-*", "* -F *", "* -T *", "* -d *") and not process.title like~ ("*://localhost*", "*://127.0.0.1*")
false_positives: Scripts created by developers and admins
author: Sentinel
